note: Attic room of the rarer pronouns (dont, soi, quiconque, auquel, duquel, the -même forms). Pronouns have no gender, so no left/right rule (divider null). The open stairwell with its banister at the front left goes back down to the conjunctions room; the white door on the far right leads to the third prepositions room. The room name sits on the small wall board left of the round window.
